title.narrative: Greening the Productive Sectors in Gambia: Promoting the Use and Integration of Small to Medium-Scale Renewable Energy Systems in the Productive Sectors

description.narrative: Based on encouraging results of the UNIDO/GEF 4 project under which has been adopted The Gambia RE Act, this project aims at supporting the greening of productive sectors in rural areas of the country. The project essentially features the installation of pilot RE systems to demonstrate relevance of the approach and the establishment of a RE Fund that will support potential entrepreneurs, mainly women and youth, who would like to invest in this domain.
